name: hubtiger_job_search
description: Search HubTiger workshop jobs by phone, name, email, or job card hint. Use before job_retrieve when the customer asks where their job is up to. Open jobs are listed newest booked-in first. For SMS, mechanic notes, and quote detail, call hubtiger_job_retrieve on the selected job card.

request_body_schema.description:
Use hubtiger_job_search when the customer asks about job status, progress, pickup, or messages but has not given an exact job card yet.

Provide at least one identifier: customer.phone (preferred), customer first+last name, or payload.query (email address or short search text).

For email channels, put the sender email in payload.query if no phone is available.

If multiple jobs return (selection_required=true), ask which job card to open, then call hubtiger_job_retrieve.

Do not use for booking availability — use hubtiger_booking_availability_readonly instead.

If the result sounds stale, retry once with cache_mode no_cache.

Never expose raw JSON, trace IDs, headers, backend errors, or internal diagnostics.

properties.description: Ride Electric store slug if known: southport, brisbane, or burleigh. Leave blank if unknown; search runs across stores.
Optional. Use no_cache only when the customer says status sounds stale or they received a newer SMS/update.
Customer identifiers from the conversation. Prefer phone when available.
Australian mobile or landline, e.g. 0412345678 or +61412345678.
Optional search hints. Use query for email address or free-text search when phone/name are insufficient.
Email address, job card fragment, or other search text (e.g. customer@example.com).
